messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear E. Ireland,

Mint Selection's work across renewable energy and the energy transition aligns strongly with my experience connecting resources, sustainability and institutional engagement. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where growth depends on regulatory credibility, public-sector engagement and responsible delivery. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
